market.question: Will George Russell be the 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion?

assessment.reasoning: Russell is 9 points behind teammate Antonelli (63 vs 72) after 3 races but holds a 22-5 qualifying head-to-head edge. Mercedes is dominant. Other oddsmakers/markets place Russell at ~41-45% implied probability. Long season with reliability and form variance ahead.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Antonelli's race-day pace continues; Mercedes intra-team rivalry.
